startup_observations.summary: PMCP catalog exposes index-it-mcp as a provisionable local manifest server.
PMCP could not connect to index-it-mcp because the server disconnected during startup.
PMCP doctor reports that the repo-local command-mode code-index-mcp config conflicts with the active system PMCP service and should use the remote gateway URL instead.
Manifest provisioning failed on CPython 3.13 because tree-sitter-languages does not publish cp313 wheels for the resolved package set.

blocked_reason.summary: No PMCP-managed stdio server was reachable for pilot tool invocations.
